summary: Iteration 12: Verified BankEzee CRM in-process auto-sync scheduler. All 6 backend tests passed. The scheduler starts on FastAPI startup, logs 'Started in-process auto-sync scheduler', and emits periodic 'Auto-sync tick' entries. Core reproduction test: hard-deleted a sheet-sourced lead directly from MongoDB (by sheet_id) WITHOUT triggering any manual sync; the lead reappeared within the wait window purely via the background scheduler, proving auto-sync works independently of the external cron. Cron endpoint returns 401 without bearer and 200 with correct WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET. Manual /api/leads/sync (admin, cookie session) returns {imported, updated, total_rows}.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is large (>1300 lines). Consider splitting into routers (auth, leads, cron, files) for maintainability.
Auth uses HTTP-only session cookies via /api/auth/login; there is no Bearer JWT path. Frontend/testers must use cookies. Documenting this in README would prevent confusion.
seed_data_creation: None. Deleted one existing sheet-sourced lead by sheet_id; auto-sync re-imported it from the Google Sheet as expected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth is cookie-based (session_token httpOnly cookie set by POST /api/auth/login). Use requests.Session(). SYNC_INTERVAL_MINUTES=2. Background scheduler task started from FastAPI startup event; verify via grep 'Auto-sync tick' in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log. WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET in backend/.env.
rca of the issue: Original bug: leads not syncing until manual click because auto-sync relied on external .emergent/crons.yml cron which was unreliable. Fix (verified): server.py adds periodic_sync_loop() spawned as asyncio task in FastAPI startup handler, runs every SYNC_INTERVAL_MINUTES*60s (min 60s) with 20s initial delay, calling sync_leads_from_sheet() in try/except. Confirmed by deleting a lead from Mongo and observing re-insert without any manual/cron trigger.
